title: RAW: arbitrary nonempty nucleus-code inventories inherit exact whole-word hitting-set lower bounds
summary: Source-free corollary of existing1355, not a new native census. If every complete source word emits at least one intact nonempty member of a fixed inventory of K written nucleus carriers inside its own output group, selecting one working sign from each carrier gives a whole-group hitting set of size at most K. Existing exact bounds therefore require K>=13/14/11 on FULL IT/RF/ZL and K>=9 on every GE2 panel. Carrier strings may be long, collide, and lack unique decoding; representatives are not identified vowels.

design.mechanism: A fully vowel-writing alphabetic channel gives each independently defined syllabic-nucleus source segment one fixed nonempty written string, or a bounded finite collection of such strings. Every complete source word contains a nucleus and preserves one such whole carrier as a contiguous substring inside its corresponding written group. This is a necessary-condition class, not a new full writer.
design.unit: Use exactly the inherited1355 strict22-working-unit complete-group panels, separately FULL and wholeforms present on at least two physical leaves (GE2), with readers separate. No unit or word-boundary claim is promoted.
design.contrast: Unlike old singleton-only source-vowel lower bounds, use all existing wholeword support constraints and recurrent sensitivity. Unlike treating1264classes as C/V, infer no sign-level phonetic class. Unlike a raw-vowel-cover equivalence claim, use only a one-way representative lemma that remains sound for multigraph codes.
proof: Let W be retained nonempty written groups and tau(W) the minimum cardinality of a sign set intersecting every group.
Let C be a fixed collection of K nonempty carrier strings. Assume each w contains at least one entire c in C. Select one sign r(c) appearing in each c.
R={r(c):c in C} intersects every w and |R|<=K, so K>=tau(W). No substring boundary recovery, prefix/suffix freedom or unique decoding is needed.
In1355 an erased set N is feasible exactly if Sigma\N intersects every word. Since |Sigma|=22, tau(W)=22-max_feasible|N|. Use TYPE maxima, not token-mass maxima.

If each independent source nucleus category has exactly one fixed nonempty written carrier, its category count must be at least tau. With at most a_j alternative carriers for category j, sum_j a_j>=tau is necessary. Multiple categories may share carriers, which cannot improve the bound.
design.smallest_decision: Independently verify this source-free implication and the existing1355 TYPE maxima. If accepted, no native vowel-subset or cluster solver is needed to exclude a <=8-carrier always-written-nucleus contract even on GE2. Only after separately sourcing a language stage and exact phonological/spelling convention may its nucleus inventory be compared. No language is selected or excluded by name here.
scope_limits: Not a recovered vowel partition. A chosen representative may also occur in consonant spellings; raw signs in R are not vowel sounds.

Abjads with omitted vowels, context-dependent abugida/CV spellings, null nucleus codes, cross-group carrier placement, abbreviations or nonlexical complete groups may violate the premise. They are not excluded.
A syllabary normally has many nucleus-containing syllable carriers; vowel phoneme count cannot replace that carrier count.

Fully phonetic source categories must include every independently syllabic segment, including syllabic consonants where permitted. Vowel letters, phonemes, long/short contrasts and diphthong analyses cannot be interchanged opportunistically.
Nonempty consonant codes are not needed for the representative proof. Nulling other material is allowed if at least one protected complete nucleus carrier remains inside each whole group.
A compatible carrier count is only non-exclusion, not a word reading, source-language probability or historical script identification.
FULL rare-form sensitivity remains;GE2 is an old sensitivity population, not holdout. Reader agreement is not independent replication.

No exhaustive novelty claim.
design.old_obligation_retained: Old singleton-only bound IT12/RF14/ZL10 remains valid under its premises. Present FULL adds only1 inIT/ZL and no RF increase; broader carrier proof and GE2>=9 are the substantive stated application.
design.access: No new native rows, source corpus, image, phoneme assignment, experiment, classifier or decoder. Existing report arithmetic only.
